rows.name: tinyMediaManager
rows.reason: Its TV/movie subtitle search and library cleanup address the subtitle requirement; seedbox transfer remains separate, and OpenSubtitles downloads require a VIP account.

rows.name: Sonarr
rows.reason: Sonarr automates TV releases using a separate downloader. Files need local access or arranged mounts/transfers; shared paths and permissions affect import and seeding.

rows.name: MediaManager
rows.reason: Plausible TV/movie replacement; identity inferred. Subtitle-file import documented, provider acquisition/Bazarr/seedbox unverified. Transmission needs same-volume paths; other-client applicability unknown. Migration renames roots/requires filenames/layouts; test sample copies.

rows.name: MediaWiki
rows.reason: Its collaborative-documentation function has no concrete role in media acquisition, seedbox-file import, or subtitle management for this question.

rows.name: Medusa
rows.reason: TV-focused manager integrates subtitle searches and post-processing, with seedbox documentation. TV scope does not establish a full movie-stack replacement; the seedbox guide covers one provider's environment.

rows.name: Tautulli
rows.reason: Plex monitoring and notification scripts are peripheral here; no Plex-specific requirement is established, and the documented features do not directly provide subtitles or seedbox-file import.

rows.name: Bazarr
rows.reason: Bazarr supports subtitle-language profiles, provider searches and synchronization for Sonarr/Radarr. Requires provider configuration and access to the same media; test language/provider coverage on actual shows.

rows.name: Radarr
rows.reason: Radarr supplies the movie-management part of a modular alternative, including release prioritization and documented shared-storage requirements. Adds another service and still needs accessible download/library folders plus a separate subtitle solution.

rows.name: Subgen
rows.reason: Subgen transcribes local media or translates foreign speech into English through a Bazarr-compatible service. CPU/GPU costs and quality review apply; arbitrary target-language translation was not established.

rows.name: Tautulli
rows.reason: Plex playback monitoring/statistics/history/notifications do not supply acquisition/library/subtitle/seedbox management. Analytics wasn't requested; script hooks alone do not establish the missing workflow.

rows.name: MediaManager
rows.reason: MediaManager integrates TV/movie management and external download clients. Client API access still requires accessible downloaded files; a complete foreign-subtitle workflow was not verified.

rows.name: tinyMediaManager
rows.reason: Subtitle download requires PRO and OpenSubtitles VIP; library adjunct needs accessible seedbox files. Provider/language/file access unverified. Whole acquisition replacement unestablished; paid features are not prohibited.

rows.name: Sonarr + Radarr + Bazarr with the existing seedbox downloader
rows.reason: Subtitle workflow documented; languages/coverage/providers unspecified. Seedbox client/API/visibility/permissions/seeding need end-to-end verification. Sonarr evidence only indexed excerpts. Sources have post-question revisions; no complete January 2026 snapshot.

rows.name: SeedSync
rows.reason: SeedSync transfers selected files automatically from Linux seedboxes to local servers through SSH/LFTP. Requires remote SSH and separate import/seeding design; it is not a media or subtitle manager.

rows.name: MediaWiki
rows.reason: MediaWiki is a wiki collaboration/documentation platform, outside media acquisition, library or subtitle workflows. No documentation-platform need is supplied; exclusion concerns operating scope, not an invented mandatory condition.
